en-US.title: Auto Video Editor — Tenfold
en-US.subtitle: Bulk Edit & Silence Remover
en-US.description:
Film ten takes. Post ten videos.

Tenfold is an auto video editor for talking-to-camera clips. Import a whole batch of videos at once, pick the edits you want, and Tenfold edits every clip for you: silences cut, filler words gone, repeated takes removed, framed for vertical. One tap, a whole batch of finished videos.

BULK EDITING, DONE FOR YOU
• Edit 10 or more videos at the same time
• Silence remover: cuts dead air and long pauses to a natural beat
• Removes filler words ("um", "uh", "like") and repeated takes
• Pick the edits once for the whole batch, or change them for a single clip
• Reframes for 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9, with a subtle zoom at each cut

SAVE HOURS EVERY WEEK
• Skip trimming clips by hand: film today, post all week
• Check each video, then save the whole batch to Photos

A REAL EDITOR WHEN YOU WANT ONE
• Trim, split, reorder and join clips on a timeline
• Word-by-word captions in your style
• Titles and hooks with a text tool: nine styles, drag, pinch and rotate
• Add music or a voiceover; music dips under speech automatically
• Undo, redo and revert to the original at any time

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Editing and transcription run on your iPhone. No account, no video upload, no waiting for a server. Your videos never leave your phone.

Privacy: https://ibrahim1774.github.io/tenfold/privacy.html
en-US.promoText: Film ten takes, get ten finished videos. Tenfold cuts the silences, pauses and filler words from every clip at once, right on your iPhone.

review.notes:
Tenfold has no accounts and no server for video processing. All video processing runs on the device with Apple's on-device speech recognition (iOS 26). Videos, audio and transcripts never leave the device.

Subscription required: Tenfold has no free plan. After onboarding, the subscription screen (presented with the Superwall SDK) is shown, and the app opens only with an active subscription or free trial. Plans, sold through the App Store: Starter (monthly and yearly, no free trial), Pro and Studio (monthly and yearly, each with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers). To test, sign in with a Sandbox Apple Account and buy any plan or start a Pro or Studio trial. Restore purchases is on the subscription screen (and in the You tab once subscribed).

To test editing: tap Import clips and pick one or more videos with speech from Photos, choose the edits to apply, then Generate. Open a finished video to reach the editor: Captions, Text, Audio and the + tile for adding clips. Export saves to Photos.

App Tracking Transparency: the tracking prompt appears on the first onboarding tap. The advertising identifier is used only for ad attribution (AppsFlyer, and Superwall's install attribution), and only if tracking is allowed; the app works the same if tracking is declined. Usage analytics (PostHog) are not used for tracking.

Permissions are requested only when used: camera and microphone for in-app recording, Photos for opening chosen videos and saving exports, speech recognition for captions.
